name: Can door adjustment help with improving home security?

mainEntity.name: Can door adjustment help with improving home security?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, proper door adjustment can significantly improve home security. A door that latches and locks correctly is much more secure than one with misaligned hardware. Adjustments can ensure that the strike plate aligns perfectly with the deadbolt and latch, allowing them to fully engage. This prevents forced entry attempts due to loose fittings or a poorly seated lock. For residents in areas like West Boise or South Boise Village, ensuring your exterior doors are properly adjusted is a fundamental step in home security.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper door adjustment improves home security by ensuring locks and latches fully engage, preventing easy forced entry.
